original_record.question:
Ralf has a number of equally big plastic plates each in the form of a regular five sided shape. He glues them together along the sides to form a complete ring (see picture). Out of how many of these plates is the ring made up?
<image1>
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.objects: 4 complete regular pentagons joined successively along full sides; dashed circular ring guide and two short dashed continuation fragments

answer_verification.method: Regular pentagon interior108degrees. At inner ring vertex two pentagon angles leave144degrees; inner regular polygon exterior36degrees, so360/36=10 plates.

ambiguities: Circular guide and short continuation marks represent layout/extension only, not additional given circles.
